title: Spirometry and Lung Function Tests — Obstruction, Restriction and Exercise Planning

hook.en: A lung function report tells you why a patient is breathless and how hard they can safely exercise. Learn the key numbers, the two patterns and how to use them.
hook.ur: Lung function report batati hai mareez ko saans ki tangi kyun hai aur woh kitni mehfooz tareeqe se exercise kar sakta hai. Aham numbers, do patterns aur unka istemal seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll define FEV1, FVC and the FEV1/FVC ratio, tell an obstructive from a restrictive pattern, read the bronchodilator response and GOLD grade of COPD and use the result to plan exercise and breathing strategies.
goal.ur: End tak aap FEV1, FVC aur FEV1/FVC ratio ki tareef karenge, obstructive ko restrictive pattern se alag karenge, bronchodilator response aur COPD ke GOLD grade parhenge aur nateeje se exercise aur saans ki strategies ka plan banayenge.

text.en: In **spirometry** the patient takes a full breath in and blows out as **hard and fast** as possible. Two key numbers come from it: **FVC** (forced vital capacity: the total air blown out) and **FEV1** (the air blown out in the **first second**). The **FEV1/FVC ratio** shows how quickly the air leaves the lungs. A ratio **below 0.70** after a bronchodilator suggests **airflow obstruction** (as in COPD and asthma). A **normal ratio with a low FVC** suggests a **restrictive** pattern (the lungs cannot fully expand).
text.ur: **Spirometry** mein mareez poori saans andar leta hai aur jitni **zor aur tezi** se ho sake bahar phoonkta hai. Do aham number milte hain: **FVC** (forced vital capacity: bahar nikli kul hawa) aur **FEV1** (**pehle second** mein bahar nikli hawa). **FEV1/FVC ratio** batata hai hawa phephron se kitni tezi se nikalti hai. Bronchodilator ke baad ratio **0.70 se kam** hona **hawa ke bahaao ki rukawat (obstruction)** batata hai (COPD aur asthma mein). **Normal ratio ke saath kam FVC** **restrictive** pattern batata hai (phephre poori tarah phail nahi sakte).

text.en: Think of the lungs as **a balloon with a straw**. Obstruction is a narrow straw: you can fill the balloon, but the air leaves slowly (low ratio). Restriction is a small, stiff balloon: air leaves at a normal speed, but there is less of it (low FVC, normal ratio). The two problems feel the same (breathless) but need different thinking.
text.ur: Phephron ko **sharbat ki nali wala ghubara** samjhein. Obstruction tang nali hai: ghubara bhar sakta hai magar hawa aahista nikalti hai (ratio kam). Restriction chhota, sakht ghubara hai: hawa normal raftar se nikalti hai magar kam hoti hai (FVC kam, ratio normal). Dono masle ek jaise mehsoos hote hain (saans ki tangi) magar mukhtalif soch maangte hain.

steps.title: Check the quality
steps.detail: A good test has a smooth, full blow and repeats well (the best two results should agree). A poor effort gives falsely low numbers. || Quality check karein

steps.title: Look at the ratio
steps.detail: FEV1/FVC below 0.70 (or below the lower limit of normal) after a bronchodilator means obstruction. Normal ratio with low FVC suggests restriction, which needs further tests. || Ratio dekhein

steps.title: Grade the severity
steps.detail: For COPD, GOLD grades use FEV1 percent of predicted after a bronchodilator: grade 1 (mild) 80 percent or more, grade 2 (moderate) 50 to 79, grade 3 (severe) 30 to 49, grade 4 (very severe) under 30. || Shiddat ka grade

steps.title: Use it for the plan
steps.detail: Combine the numbers with symptoms, oxygen levels and a walking test. Plan exercise by effort scale and symptoms (not only by numbers), teach breathing control and airway clearance if needed, and tell the doctor about unexplained changes. || Plan ke liye istemal karein

question.en: A patient has an FEV1/FVC ratio of 0.58 after a bronchodilator. What does this suggest?
question.ur: Mareez ka bronchodilator ke baad FEV1/FVC ratio 0.58 hai. Yeh kya batata hai?

text.en: Airflow obstruction, as in COPD or asthma
text.ur: Hawa ke bahaao mein rukawat, jaise COPD ya asthma mein

feedback.en: Yes — a ratio below 0.70 means the air leaves slowly.
feedback.ur: Haan — 0.70 se kam ratio ka matlab hawa aahista nikalti hai.

feedback.en: Restriction has a normal ratio with a low FVC.
feedback.ur: Restriction mein normal ratio aur kam FVC hota hai.

rows.en: Pulmonary fibrosis, chest wall disease, severe obesity, weak breathing muscles
rows.ur: Phephron ki fibrosis, chest wall ki bimari, shadeed motapa, kamzor saans ke muscles

rows.en: Breathing control, airway clearance, exercise training
rows.ur: Saans par qaboo, airway clearance, exercise training

rows.en: Exercise training, chest expansion, oxygen and pacing
rows.ur: Exercise training, chest expansion, oxygen aur pacing

text.en: **Ratio tells the pattern, FEV1 tells the severity.** First check the ratio for obstruction, then grade by FEV1. Always match the numbers to the patient: two people with the same FEV1 can feel very different.
text.ur: **Ratio pattern batata hai, FEV1 shiddat.** Pehle obstruction ke liye ratio dekhein, phir FEV1 se grade karein. Hamesha numbers ko mareez se milayein: ek jaisa FEV1 rakhne wale do log bohat mukhtalif mehsoos kar sakte hain.

text.en: **Prescribing exercise only from the FEV1.** Lung function does not predict how well a patient can train: motivated patients with severe COPD benefit a lot. Use symptoms, oxygen levels, a walking test and the effort scale, and treat the leg muscles too.
text.ur: **Sirf FEV1 se exercise prescribe karna.** Lung function nahi batata mareez kitni achhi training kar sakta hai: shadeed COPD ke mareez jo hausla rakhte hon bohat faida uthate hain. Alamaat, oxygen levels, chalne ka test aur effort scale istemal karein, aur taangon ke muscles ka bhi ilaj karein.

question.en: In asthma, which result shows reversible obstruction?
question.ur: Asthma mein kaun sa nateeja reversible obstruction dikhata hai?

text.en: A normal ratio with a low FVC
text.ur: Normal ratio ke saath kam FVC
Bronchodilator ke baad koi tabdeeli nahi

text.en: FEV1 rising by 12 percent and 200 mL or more after a bronchodilator
text.ur: Bronchodilator ke baad FEV1 ka 12 percent aur 200 mL ya zyada barhna

feedback.en: Yes — a clear improvement suggests asthma rather than fixed COPD.
feedback.ur: Haan — saaf behtari asthma ki taraf ishara karti hai, sthir COPD ki nahi.

question.en: Which factor can falsely lower spirometry numbers?
question.ur: Kaun si cheez spirometry ke numbers ko ghalat taur par kam kar sakti hai?

feedback.en: That does not alter the test much.
feedback.ur: Is se test par khaas farq nahi parta.

text.en: A poor effort or a leak around the mouthpiece
text.ur: Kamzor koshish ya mouthpiece ke gird leak

text.en: **Teach the patient their numbers.** For a patient with COPD, explain their stage in plain words ("your lungs work at about half of expected"), link it to their symptoms and set goals that do not depend on the numbers alone, such as walking to the mosque. Repeat the test only when the doctor advises.
text.ur: **Mareez ko unke numbers sikhayein.** COPD ke mareez ko unka stage saade alfaz mein samjhayein ("aap ke phephre mutawaqqa se takreeban aadha kaam karte hain"), isay alamaat se jorein aur aise maqasid rakhein jo sirf numbers par munhasir na hon, maslan masjid tak chalna. Test tab hi dohrayein jab doctor mashwara de.

question.en: Why is the ratio checked after a bronchodilator?
question.ur: Ratio bronchodilator ke baad kyun check hota hai?

answer.en: Giving a bronchodilator opens reversible narrowing, so what remains is the fixed obstruction that defines COPD. Testing before it can overstate the obstruction in a person with reversible asthma.
answer.ur: Bronchodilator dene se reversible tangi khul jati hai, is liye jo bachta hai woh sthir obstruction hai jo COPD ko tay karta hai. Pehle test karne se reversible asthma wale shakhs mein obstruction zyada nazar aa sakti hai.

beats.patient: A 62-year-old former smoker has a post-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC of 0.55 and an FEV1 of 55 percent of predicted. He is breathless on stairs but walks 400 m in six minutes.
beats.assessment: The ratio shows obstruction, and the FEV1 gives GOLD grade 2 (moderate) COPD.
beats.treatment: Start an exercise programme (walking and leg strengthening) at moderate effort, teach pursed-lip breathing and pacing, and review progress with a walking test.
beats.reassess: After 8 weeks he walks 450 m and manages the stairs with fewer stops.

text.en: **Refer urgently** for sudden severe breathlessness, blue lips, a rapid drop in oxygen level, chest pain, coughing blood or confusion. Do not start vigorous exercise on a day with worsening symptoms or fever. Follow the doctor's advice on inhalers and oxygen, and do not alter medicines.
text.ur: **Foran refer karein** achanak shadeed saans ki tangi, neelay honth, oxygen level ka tezi se girna, seene ka dard, khoon ki khansi ya uljhan. Alamaat barhne ya bukhar ke din sakht exercise shuru na karein. Inhalers aur oxygen par doctor ka mashwara maanein, aur dawaiyan na badlein.

summary.en: Spirometry gives FEV1 and FVC; an FEV1/FVC ratio below about 0.70 after a bronchodilator shows obstruction, and a low FVC with a normal ratio suggests restriction.
summary.ur: Spirometry FEV1 aur FVC deti hai; bronchodilator ke baad takreeban 0.70 se kam FEV1/FVC ratio obstruction dikhata hai, aur normal ratio ke saath kam FVC restriction batata hai.

summary.en: COPD is graded by FEV1 percent predicted (GOLD 1 to 4); a large reversible response favours asthma.
summary.ur: COPD ka grade FEV1 percent predicted se hota hai (GOLD 1 se 4); bari reversible tabdeeli asthma ki taraf ishara karti hai.

summary.en: Plan exercise by symptoms, effort and a walking test, not the FEV1 alone, and refer urgently for severe breathlessness.
summary.ur: Exercise ka plan alamaat, effort aur chalne ke test se banayein, sirf FEV1 se nahi, aur shadeed saans ki tangi par foran refer karein.

back.en: The air blown out in the first second of a forced breath.
back.ur: Zor se saans nikalne ke pehle second mein nikli hawa.

front.ur: Kaun sa ratio obstruction batata hai?

back.en: FEV1/FVC below about 0.70 after a bronchodilator.
back.ur: Bronchodilator ke baad FEV1/FVC takreeban 0.70 se kam.

front.en: What pattern has a low FVC and a normal ratio?
front.ur: Kaun sa pattern kam FVC aur normal ratio rakhta hai?

back.en: Moderate COPD, FEV1 50 to 79 percent of predicted.
back.ur: Darmiyana COPD, FEV1 predicted ka 50 se 79 percent.

note.en: Measure what the patient can do.
note.ur: Naapein mareez kya kar sakta hai.
Saans par qaboo aur pacing sikhayein.
